```{r}
#| label: setup

library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
tidymodels_prefer()
```


```{r}
#| label: data

rm(list = ls())
data("ames")
```

```{r}
#| label: 嵌套

ames |>
  mutate(Overall_Cond = fct_relevel(Overall_Cond, "Very_Poor")) |>
  nest(data = -MS_Zoning) -> nested_data
```


```{r}
#| label: 建模

# model ----
model <- multinom_reg() |>
  set_engine("nnet")

# formula ----
formula <- as.formula("Overall_Cond ~ Year_Built + Gr_Liv_Area")

# recipe(preprocess) ----
prep <- recipe(formula = formula, data = ames) |>
  step_dummy(all_nominal(), -all_outcomes()) |>
  step_normalize(all_predictors()) |>
  prep()
```

```{r}
#| label: 应用

nested_data |>
  mutate(tidy = map(data, \(data) {
    model |>
      fit(formula = formula,
          data = prep |>
            bake(data)) |>
      tidy(conf.int = TRUE)
  })) -> nested_data

nested_data |>
  mutate(tidy = map(tidy, ~filter(., term != "(Intercept)"))) |>
  select(-data) |>
  unnest(tidy) -> result
```
